# Amazon Q Business API Reference — captured 2026-07-06

## Service Endpoints

### QBusiness
- Fully managed, generative-AI powered enterprise chat assistant
- Key Capabilities: Question-answering, knowledge discovery, writing email messages, summarizing text, drafting document outlines, brainstorming ideas
- Note on page: Q Business closes to new customers July 31, 2026 (availability change; not reportable).

### QApps
- Web experience feature within Amazon Q Business
- Lightweight, purpose-built AI apps (marketing content, customer email, promotional content)

## Documentation Resources
- Amazon Q Business User Guide / API operations overview
- IAM roles for Amazon Q Business
- Q Apps capabilities / API operations overview

Updated: 2026-07-06 — Welcome page unchanged (still only QBusiness + QApps groups; new-customer availability note present). No new API operation groups. No reportable addition.
